title: Vanishing Taylor residuals on arbitrary fine grids
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Vanishing Taylor residuals on arbitrary fine grids. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: On any compact pseudometric time space, take finite grids whose neighboring time distances vanish uniformly. If the sums of squared state increments converge in measure to a real-valued random variable Q, then the sums of second-order Taylor residuals converge in measure to zero.
